> Staff and their access, on a clinic's own subdomain. The same chain as branches.routes.ts, in the same order, for the same reasons. Three permissions, deliberately separate: iam.user.read see who works here and what they hold iam.permission.assign change what they may do iam.user.update employment record only — grants nothing iam.user.suspend cut off access without unpicking the roles Seeing the staff list does not imply changing it, and a practice manager who keeps employee codes up to date has no business assigning roles. Splitting them costs one line each here and is the difference between a role model and a single "admin" flag. Everything acts on a MEMBERSHIP id, never a user id: a pers…
